about: THE WAR MAP's data (docs/war_map_v1.md): one file for every skin (the King's parchment now; the Clockmaker's brass map and the Naturalist's specimen chart read the same (docs/war_map_act2.md); Act 3's world and THE CLOCK: docs/war_map_act3.md). Points are [lon, lat]; outlines are flat [lon, lat, lon, lat, ...]. Holders: empire (the plain purple of the empire), crown, contested, machine, brood, unrest, unknown (blank). Rules run in order, a later one wins. EVERY TEXT IS A PLACEHOLDER.
title: THE WAR MAP

marks.label: The old mine: the crates of 2767
The honest masters, at the coast
The Queen: where nobody has been
The fleet off the Tiber's mouth

pins.title: The Gold of Vila Rica
pins.about: Tomasz, a missionary in Brazil now, and the garrison stop the Free Assembly's rising in the gold town.

pins.title: The City of Gears
pins.about: The guild founds a free city over an old mine; the valley below fears it from the first day.

pins.title: The Mission of São Rafael
pins.about: The swarm comes out of the flooded forest at Tomasz's mission: bring the people to the river fort.

pins.title: The Queen
pins.about: The flood comes to Lindqvist's island; in the pens the strongest Mother grows into a Queen.

pins.title: The Council of Gears
pins.about: The city's machines begin to vote through the masters who wind them. Hollweg at the great spring.

pins.title: Down the Rivers
pins.about: Valadares holds the Barra against the swarm in the floods and brings the people of Nazaré out.

pins.title: Between Two Fires
pins.about: The army of Brazil marches to the fort at the crossroads; both fires find it. The Crown chooses which first.

pins.title: The Jungle Front
pins.about: The army's jungle column breaks the swarm's nests on the river, Valadares leading it.

pins.title: The Siege of Concórdia
pins.about: The army's southern column lays siege to the city of gears, Father Ferrer as Rome's witness.

pins.title: The Hold
pins.about: Optional. Eggs found in a Brazilian ship's hold at Luanda: hunt what hatched before the tide takes it.

pins.title: The Mining Machines
pins.about: Optional. Concórdia's mining machines wake in the Viceroy's arsenal at Goa, Father Ferrer arriving.

pins.place: Brazil, the road to the coast
pins.title: Brazil After the Fires
pins.about: Ruggieri brings the colonists of the burnt interior down to the coast, the grown danger at their backs.

pins.title: The Silver Mountain
pins.about: Optional. Something works the deep galleries of the silver mountain at night: drive the machines out of the mine.

pins.title: The Last Ride of the Governor
pins.about: Old Fairleigh brings Virginia's people over the river to the north, the swarm at the farms. A choice: ride out, or ride with them.

pins.title: The King of Kongo
pins.about: Tomasz and the Catholic King of Kongo hold his city when the swarm comes out of the hinterland.

pins.title: Up the Great River
pins.about: Father Inácio's balloon finds the nests; Valadares takes the river column up after them.

pins.title: The Naturalist Taken
pins.about: Valadares finds Lindqvist at a new pen beside an old ruin of the labs. A choice: seal the ruin, or open its records.

pins.title: The Highland Wall
pins.about: Optional. Ethiopia's highlands hold the swarm at their foot, where the nights are cold: hold the passes with the Emperor's men.

pins.title: The Arsenal of Goa
pins.about: The guild's last hands and Father Ferrer burn the Machine's seed out of the Viceroy's arsenal in the monsoon.

pins.title: The Praying Clockmakers
pins.about: The Christian clockmakers of Nagasaki teach Hollweg how to stop it. A choice: ring the stop-work now, or keep it.

pins.title: The Foundries of Manila
pins.about: Optional. The lake's foundries cast for the Machine: Tomasz and Manila's militia take them back.

pins.title: The Spice Islands
pins.about: The machines and the swarm meet on the spice islands for the first time outside Brazil, and the Crown between them.

pins.title: The Exiles' Rising
pins.about: The Free Assembly's exiles rise at Sydney Cove. A choice: the swift answer, canister, or the King's pardon.

pins.title: The Gold Fields
pins.about: Machines came on a Manila ship to dig the gold fields: Hollweg and the guild's last hands hunt them in the hills.

pins.title: The Northern Shore
pins.about: Optional. A drifting hulk comes ashore in the mangroves: played as the creatures it carried, told from Valadares' chart.

pins.title: The Cold Forge
pins.about: Optional. Hollweg and Valadares go south of every map to the forge the Machine keeps in the ice.

pins.title: Lisbon (the night)
pins.about: The night the world caught fire: Tomasz, Captain Amaral and Father Inácio at Lisbon's port and old city.

pins.title: Goa (the night)
pins.about: The same night at Goa: Hollweg and Father Ferrer at the old city and the arsenal. Ferrer's last night.

pins.title: The Atlantic Port (the night)
pins.about: The same night on the Atlantic: Luanda, Veracruz or Salvador, as the ledger leaves them.

pins.title: The Tiber
pins.about: The present. The heir takes his first command at the Milvian Bridge against the Machine's vanguard.

pins.title: Rome
pins.about: The siege of Rome, the Machine from the north and the creatures from the marshes. The final choice.

clock.about: THE CLOCK (docs/war_map_act3.md): the year turns after every per_year wins of Act 3's theatre missions (an optional one counts optional_weight); at each turn the unsettled theatre left alone longest, for at least grace years, loses its next colony (ties: the one whose next colony goes to the creatures, then `tie`). A theatre whose core missions are all won is SETTLED. `head`: years of neglect a theatre starts with (the sparks of Act 2 that got away). `reclaim`: a colony that fell comes back (and is safe) when the mission at its place is won so. The clock stops when the night begins.
